records.source: Hey, it's Mr. @, the new farmer! I'm Pierre, owner of the local general store.^Hey, it's Ms. @, the new farmer! I'm Pierre, owner of the local general store.#$b#If you're looking for seeds, my shop is the place to go. I'll also buy produce from you for a good price!#$e#A little agriculture could really inject new life into the local economy!
records.translation: Uy, si Ginoong @, ang bagong magsasaka! Ako si Pierre, may-ari ng tindahang pangkalahatan dito.^Uy, si Binibining @, ang bagong magsasaka! Ako si Pierre, may-ari ng tindahang pangkalahatan dito.#$b#Kung naghahanap ka ng mga binhi, tindahan ko ang dapat puntahan. Bibili rin ako ng ani mo sa magandang presyo!#$e#Talagang makapagbibigay ng bagong sigla sa lokal na ekonomiya ang kaunting pagsasaka!

records.source: How can I possibly compete with Joja?$s#$e#Their pockets are so deep, they can just sell at a loss until little guys like me are out of business... then they'll jack up their prices!$s
records.translation: Paano ako makikipagkumpitensiya sa Joja?$s#$e#Napakalalim ng bulsa nila kaya maaari silang magbenta nang palugi hanggang magsara ang maliliit na negosyong tulad ko... Pagkatapos ay itataas nila ang mga presyo!$s

records.source: Wow, I can't believe you'd give this to me. It must've cost you a fortune! Thanks!
records.translation: Wow, hindi ako makapaniwalang ibibigay mo ito sa akin. Tiyak na napakalaki ng halaga nito! Salamat!

records.source: Gripping! Fascinating! It's the perfect book for me!$h
records.translation: Nakaaakit! Nakamamangha! Perpektong aklat ito para sa akin!$h

records.source: Gahh, no customers! Any more of this 'green' rain, and my ledger will be in the 'red'!$s
records.translation: Gahh, walang mamimili! Kapag nagpatuloy pa ang “berdeng” ulang ito, malulugi ako at mapupula ang talaan ko!$s

records.source: Well, I'm glad things are back to normal. Seems like it was all overblown... just like everything.
records.translation: Aba, natutuwa akong bumalik na sa normal ang lahat. Mukhang pinalaki lang pala ang usapin... gaya ng lahat ng bagay.

records.source: Glad to see you, @. What's a little toxic rain when you have seeds to buy?$h#$e#I'm just kidding. The rain seems to be completely harmless.
records.translation: Natutuwa akong makita ka, @. Ano ba ang kaunting nakalalasong ulan kung may mga binhing bibilhin?$h#$e#Nagbibiro lang ako. Hindi pala mapanganib ang ulan.

records.source: Abigail's going through a rebellious phase... I get it.#$e#She'll wise up when she has to make her first mortgage payment!$h
records.translation: Dumaraan si Abigail sa mapaghimagsik na yugto... Nauunawaan ko iyon.#$e#Matututo rin siyang mag-isip nang tama kapag kailangan na niyang bayaran ang una niyang sangla!$h

records.source: I'm determined to keep my shop running until the bitter end.$s#$b#Morris and his cronies will have to drag me out from behind the counter, kicking and screaming!$h
records.translation: Determinado akong panatilihing bukas ang tindahan hanggang sa mapait na wakas.$s#$b#Kakailanganin nina Morris at ng mga kasabwat niya na kaladkarin ako mula sa likod ng kaha habang sumisipa at sumisigaw!$h

records.source: I'm losing a lot of money being away from the shop...$s#$b#But, you know what? It's worth it.
records.translation: Malaki ang nawawala kong pera dahil malayo ako sa tindahan...$s#$b#Pero alam mo? Sulit ito.

records.source: Mmm... that salty smell of the sea is making me want some sashimi.
records.translation: Mmm... Dahil sa maalat na amoy ng dagat, gusto kong kumain ng sashimi.

records.source: Eh, let the kids play in the sun. I'll just sit in this chair.
records.translation: Ah, hayaan mong maglaro sa araw ang mga bata. Uupo lang ako sa silyang ito.

records.source: Drink after drink... Gus must be making a killing!
records.translation: Sunod-sunod ang inumin... Tiyak na kumikita nang malaki si Gus!

records.source: Well, now that you have dual incomes, I expect you'll be purchasing twice as many seeds, right?$h#$b#Haha... I'm only joking.... *ahem*...
records.translation: Aba, ngayong dalawa na ang kumikita sa inyo, inaasahan kong doble rin ang bibilhin ninyong binhi, hindi ba?$h#$b#Haha... Nagbibiro lang ako... *ahem*...

records.source: Hello, er... ${my son^daughter}$?$s
records.translation: Kumusta, ah... ${anak kong lalaki^anak kong babae}$?$s

records.source: This is a dream-come-true! You can't begin to imagine how much stress JojaMart was causing me.#$e#For a small town like this, one store is enough! There's too much social pressure for me to overcharge, anyway.
records.translation: Natupad ang pangarap ko! Hindi mo kayang isipin kung gaanong pag-aalala ang idinulot sa akin ng JojaMart.#$e#Sapat na ang isang tindahan para sa munting bayang tulad nito! Masyado namang matindi ang presyur ng lipunan para makapaningil ako nang sobra.

records.source: This is a sad day for Pelican Town... The stronger Joja becomes, the closer I move toward bankruptcy. I might have to sell the shop soon...$s
records.translation: Malungkot na araw ito para sa Bayan ng Pelican... Habang lumalakas ang Joja, mas lumalapit ako sa pagkalugi. Baka kailangan kong ibenta ang tindahan sa lalong madaling panahon...$s

records.source: Hey, that's a great idea... It'll be nice to get out from behind the counter. I'll meet you there!
records.translation: Uy, napakagandang ideya niyan... Masarap namang makaalis sa likod ng kaha. Magkita tayo roon!

records.source: Welcome! If you're looking for seeds, you've come to the right place!
records.translation: Maligayang pagdating! Kung naghahanap ka ng mga binhi, nasa tamang lugar ka!

records.source: Hello, er... ${my son^daughter}$?$s
records.translation: Kumusta, ah... ${anak kong lalaki^anak kong babae}$?$s

records.source: Hi, @. Need any seeds or fruit tree saplings?
records.translation: Kumusta, @. Kailangan mo ba ng mga binhi o punla ng punong namumunga?

records.source: Hi, @. How's Abigail doing? The shop hasn't been the same without her...
records.translation: Kumusta, @. Kumusta si Abigail? Hindi na katulad ng dati ang tindahan kapag wala siya...

records.source: Sometimes I get new items in stock, so make sure to stop by every so often.#$e#It's a lot of work to run a shop.$h
records.translation: Minsan ay may mga bago akong paninda, kaya tiyaking dumaan paminsan-minsan.#$e#Napakaraming trabaho ang pagpapatakbo ng tindahan.$h

records.source: You know, I used to be a pretty good boxer back in the day... my right hook was the stuff of legend!$h
records.translation: Alam mo, mahusay akong boksingero noong araw... Maalamat ang kanang hook ko!$h

records.source: $d Joja#It's my day off today.#$e#Hmmm... what to do...$s|If you find any wild produce, I'll take it off your hands for a reasonable price.
records.translation: $d Joja#Wala akong pasok ngayon.#$e#Hmmm... Ano ang gagawin ko...$s|Kung makakahanap ka ng ligaw na ani, bibilhin ko iyon sa iyo sa makatuwirang presyo.

records.source: #$1 pierre1#*sigh*... No matter how well the business does, it's never enough to satisfy my desire for success. What's wrong with me? Maybe I'm just bored with domestic life.$s#$e#When I was younger I always had something interesting to do... now I find myself just wasting time whenever I'm not at work.$s
records.translation: #$1 pierre1#*buntong-hininga*... Gaano man kaganda ang negosyo, hindi iyon sapat upang masiyahan ang hangarin kong magtagumpay. Ano ang mali sa akin? Baka nababagot lang ako sa buhay sa tahanan.$s#$e#Noong mas bata ako, palagi akong may kawili-wiling ginagawa... Ngayon ay nagsasayang lang ako ng oras tuwing wala ako sa trabaho.$s

records.source: I'm happy to buy any produce off you.#$b#I'll give you a fair price, of course!
records.translation: Masaya akong bilhin ang anumang ani mo.#$b#Siyempre, babayaran kita sa makatarungang halaga!

records.source: I really do appreciate your business, Mr. @. I've been having a harder and harder time turning a decent profit.^I really do appreciate your business, Ms. @. I've been having a harder and harder time turning a decent profit.
records.translation: Talagang pinahahalagahan ko ang pagtangkilik mo, Ginoong @. Pahirap nang pahirap para sa akin ang kumita nang maayos.^Talagang pinahahalagahan ko ang negosyo mo, Binibining @. Pahirap nang pahirap para sa akin ang kumita nang maayos.

records.source: #$1 pierre2#Does Abigail look anything like me? Don't tell my wife, but sometimes I wonder if I'm really the father.$k$s#$e#Don't tell my wife, but I hate to cook dinner.
records.translation: #$1 pierre2#May pagkakahawig ba sa akin si Abigail? Huwag mong sabihin sa asawa ko, pero minsan ay iniisip ko kung ako nga ba talaga ang ama niya.$k$s#$e#Huwag mong sabihin sa asawa ko, pero ayaw na ayaw kong magluto ng hapunan.

records.source: #$1 pierreJoja#Business has been slow since Joja moved into town. It's hard to compete with their selection.$k$s#$e#Hi there. Is your farm doing well?#$e#Maybe a few of my seeds will spruce things up.
records.translation: #$1 pierreJoja#Mahina ang negosyo mula nang dumating sa bayan ang Joja. Mahirap tapatan ang dami ng mapagpipilian sa kanila.$k$s#$e#Kumusta. Maayos ba ang bukid mo?#$e#Baka pagandahin iyon ng ilan sa mga binhi ko.

records.source: If you find any wild produce, I'll take it off your hands for a reasonable price.
records.translation: Kung makakahanap ka ng ligaw na ani, bibilhin ko iyon sa iyo sa makatuwirang presyo.

records.source: I'll tell you a secret. Sometimes, when the store is empty, I'll practice my opera singing behind the counter.$h#$e#Don't tell anyone.
records.translation: May sasabihin akong lihim. Minsan, kapag walang tao sa tindahan, nagsasanay akong kumanta ng opera sa likod ng kaha.$h#$e#Huwag mong sabihin kaninuman.

records.source: #$1 pierreBlue#*sigh*... I've got those behind-the-counter blues...$k$s#$e#I wish I could go for a walk, but I can't leave the store unattended.#$e#I've heard the flowers are in bloom and the air smells great...$s
records.translation: #$1 pierreBlue#*buntong-hininga*... Malungkot na naman ako sa likod ng kaha...$k$s#$e#Sana makapaglakad-lakad ako, pero hindi ko maaaring iwanang walang bantay ang tindahan.#$e#Narinig kong namumukadkad ang mga bulaklak at napakabango ng hangin...$s

records.source: $d joja#Some day I'm going to open a new shop in the city and make a killing.#$e#Unfortunately, business is so slow I can hardly save any money...$s|Business has been pretty good since JojaMart closed down.
records.translation: $d joja#Balang araw, magbubukas ako ng bagong tindahan sa lungsod at kikita nang malaki.#$e#Sa kasamaang-palad, napakahina ng negosyo kaya halos wala akong maipon...$s|Maganda ang negosyo mula nang magsara ang JojaMart.

records.source: Hey, @. You're my number one customer!
records.translation: Uy, @. Ikaw ang numero unong suki ko!

records.source: I've got summer seeds available! You'd better stock up.
records.translation: Mayroon na akong mga binhing pang-tag-init! Mabuting bumili ka nang marami.

records.source: $d joja#I'm so glad to have a day off from work.|Now that Joja is gone, I feel a responsibility to keep the shop open seven days a week. People need groceries!
records.translation: $d joja#Tuwang-tuwa akong walang pasok ngayon.|Ngayong wala na ang Joja, pananagutan kong panatilihing bukas ang tindahan pitong araw bawat linggo. Kailangan ng mga tao ng pagkain!

records.source: $d joja#Running the shop is one of the most important things in my life, but sometimes you just need a day off...|Now that Joja is gone, I feel a responsibility to keep the shop open seven days a week. People need groceries!
records.translation: $d joja#Isa sa pinakamahalagang bagay sa buhay ko ang pagpapatakbo ng tindahan, pero minsan ay kailangan mo lang ng pahinga...|Ngayong wala na ang Joja, pananagutan kong panatilihing bukas ang tindahan pitong araw bawat linggo. Kailangan ng mga tao ng pagkain!

records.source: Everyone's enjoying the weather instead of shopping... *sigh*
records.translation: Tinatamasa ng lahat ang panahon sa halip na mamili... *buntong-hininga*

records.source: Oh, hi. Are you satisfied with the quality of my summer seeds?
records.translation: Ah, kumusta. Nasiyahan ka ba sa kalidad ng mga binhing pang-tag-init ko?

records.source: Summer is a good time to eat a refreshing salad, don't you think?
records.translation: Magandang panahon ang tag-init upang kumain ng nakapagpapasiglang salad, hindi ba?

records.source: Ugh... It's so hot in here.
records.translation: Ugh... Napakainit dito.

records.source: You can't grow any crops during winter... so I have no seeds to offer you.#$e#It's really going to cut into our profits.
records.translation: Hindi ka makapagtatanim ng anumang pananim sa taglamig... kaya wala akong maiaalok na binhi.#$e#Talagang babawasan nito ang kita namin.

records.source: $d joja#Finally... a day of relaxation.|Now that Joja is gone, I feel a responsibility to keep the shop open seven days a week. People need groceries!
records.translation: $d joja#Sa wakas... isang araw ng pahinga.|Ngayong wala na ang Joja, pananagutan kong panatilihing bukas ang tindahan pitong araw bawat linggo. Kailangan ng mga tao ng pagkain!

records.source: #$1 pierreDin#I'm going to surprise Caroline tonight with dinner and a bottle of Stardew Red. Don't tell anyone!$k#$e#Hi. In the mood for a little shopping?
records.translation: #$1 pierreDin#Sosorpresahin ko si Caroline ngayong gabi ng hapunan at isang bote ng Stardew Red. Huwag mong sabihin kaninuman!$k#$e#Kumusta. Gusto mo bang mamili nang kaunti?

records.source: I mainly deal in edibles, so if you've got any ores or wood you'd better try selling them somewhere else.
records.translation: Pangunahing pagkain ang mga paninda ko, kaya kung may mineral o kahoy ka, mabuting subukan mong ibenta ang mga iyon sa ibang lugar.

records.source: Is it just me or is there a cold draft in here?
records.translation: Ako lang ba, o may malamig na hanging pumapasok dito?

records.source: If I didn't have this shop to run I would be outside right now.#$e#It would be fun to throw a snowball.
records.translation: Kung wala lang akong tindahang pinatatakbo, nasa labas ako ngayon.#$e#Masayang maghagis ng niyebeng-bola.

records.source: Fall seeds are here! Crops don't grow in winter so this is your last shot until spring.#$b#Better go all out, huh?
records.translation: Narito na ang mga binhing pang-taglagas! Hindi tumutubo ang mga pananim sa taglamig, kaya ito na ang huling pagkakataon mo hanggang tagsibol.#$b#Mabuting sulitin mo na, ano?

records.source: It's starting to get cold outside...#$b#That means more people come into the shop to warm up... Hehe.
records.translation: Nagsisimula nang lumamig sa labas...#$b#Ibig sabihin, mas maraming taong pumapasok sa tindahan upang magpainit... Hehe.

records.source: #$1 pierreMEGA#My dream is to keep opening new stores until I become extremely wealthy. Hehehe.$k#$e#Hi there. Is your farm still doing well?#$e#Maybe a few of my seeds will spruce things up.$h
records.translation: #$1 pierreMEGA#Pangarap kong patuloy na magbukas ng mga bagong tindahan hanggang maging napakayaman ko. Hehehe.$k#$e#Kumusta. Maayos pa rin ba ang bukid mo?#$e#Baka pagandahin iyon ng ilan sa mga binhi ko.$h

records.source: I'm happy to buy whatever you produce on the farm.#$e#Yes, I do resell it for a profit... but that's the benefit of being an established shop owner.#$e#Don't get any ideas...
records.translation: Masaya akong bilhin ang anumang ani mula sa bukid mo.#$e#Oo, ibinebenta ko ulit iyon nang may tubo... pero pakinabang iyon ng pagiging matagal nang may-ari ng tindahan.#$e#Huwag kang mag-isip ng kung ano-ano...

records.source: If I didn't have this shop to run I would be outside right now...#$e#The leaves look great and the mushrooms are sprouting.
records.translation: Kung wala lang akong tindahang pinatatakbo, nasa labas ako ngayon...#$e#Maganda ang mga dahon at nagsisisibol ang mga kabute.

records.source: Thanks, I appreciate that. Just forget you ever saw this, okay?$h#$b#...And I'll just forget that you were snooping around in my bedroom!
records.translation: Salamat, pinahahalagahan ko iyon. Kalimutan mo lang na nakita mo ito, sige?$h#$b#...At kakalimutan ko na rin na nakikialam ka sa silid-tulugan ko!

records.source: You would really do that to me? You're terrible.$s#$b#You shouldn't have been snooping around in my bedroom in the first place! Nosy neighbors are the worst.$3
records.translation: Talagang gagawin mo iyon sa akin? Napakasama mo.$s#$b#Hindi ka dapat nakikialam sa silid-tulugan ko sa simula pa lang! Pinakamasama ang mga usiserong kapitbahay.$3

records.source: Hey, good luck.
records.translation: Uy, suwertehin ka sana.

records.source: It feels great to be on top! Hah!$h#$e#Nice effort, though.
records.translation: Napakasarap manguna! Hah!$h#$e#Maganda naman ang pagsisikap mo.

records.source: I can't believe I lost...$s
records.translation: Hindi ako makapaniwalang natalo ako...$s
